remarks:
This thoughtfully designed 2-story home offer 3 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, and a practical, open concept layout with customizable options to fit your lifestyle. Situated on approximately a quarter acre with town utility hookups, this home features quality craftsmanship and modern finishes throughout. Exterior features include an architectural shingle roof, while interior finishes including flooring, cabinetry, countertops, paint colors, and other selections that can be personalized at our design center in Fredonia.

Tucked into a quiet corner of the town, steps from Falconer Park, you have serenity with the comfort of knowing your amenities are still close by. Walkable to school, grocery stores, and the bank and sits in an ideal Western New York commuter sweet spot, offering easy highway accessibility to both Erie, PA and Buffalo, NY.

Taxes are to be determined following completion of construction and reassessment.
